sections.title: About Murtop
text: Murtop is fast-paced arcade game packed with action, as if it was taken out directly from the 80’s, where Dig Dug meets Bomberman.
Help Murti save the world from an invasion of carrot-hungry moles with her bomb-pooping skills!
